title: fix(app-shell): Data pillar header holds the same controls on every tab (objectui#12511)
body:
Fixes #12511
Clause-②: no

The Data pillar's object header now reads the same on Records, Form, Settings and every other tab. Its right slot holds only the save status (Saving… or Saved HH:MM). Part of epic objectui#12446.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## What changed

- **Object settings icon retired** (`data-object-settings`). The Settings tab one row below is the control. When the content column is narrow, the tab is still reachable under Advanced.
- **Add field left the header.** It is a field action, offered where fields are laid out: the Form tab's toolbar chip (objectui#12451) and the Records grid's own + column (`grid-add-column`, which the grid draws from `GridFieldAuthoringProvider`). Both run the pillar's one `addField`.
- **The ⋯ More menu retired** (`data-object-more`, `data-object-add-field`). The card keeps the menu only if two or more object-level actions exist. The object-level actions in `DataPillar` today:
  - the header's Object settings, a shortcut to the Settings tab, retired here;
  - the header's More → Add field, which is a field action and moved, not an object action;
  - nothing else. The `DataPillar` region has no copy-api-name, open-in-app or delete-draft-object action. The API tab's copy buttons are for endpoint snippets inside that panel, and Publish and Changes are package-level controls in the shell header.
  - That makes zero object-level actions, so no menu is drawn and none was invented.
- The `addFieldOffered` constant, which only gated the More menu, is removed. Read-only and draft gating are unchanged: on a read-only package the grid gets no `onAddColumn` and the Form toolbar draws no add chips. A draft-only object's Records tab keeps its empty state pointing to Form, Layout.
- Retired strings, in en and zh (the designer table's only locales): `engine.studio.data.objectSettings`, `engine.studio.data.moreActions`, `engine.studio.data.addFieldTitle`. Each was read only by the removed controls.

## Deviations, each with its reason

1. Thirteen existing test suites and the helper `__tests__/dataPillarAddField.ts` were edited, all test-only. They added fields through the retired More menu or read the retired test ids and strings. The ruling asks for those tests to be updated in this PR. The helper now offers `addFieldFromGrid`, which clicks `grid-add-column`, and `addFieldFromFormToolbar`. Suites that stub the records grid draw the same `grid-add-column` from the grid's authoring context, the way the real grid does.
2. `StudioDesignSurface.gridColumns` now answers one row from its find double, because an empty list draws its empty state and no + column. It also serves the grid's row-verdict probe (`POST /api/v1/security/explain`) from a fetch double so it never reaches a socket. find stays the measurement.
3. `StudioDesignSurface.cancelledLoad-11331` reads `data-records-body` as its 'object opened' signal. It used to read the retired More trigger. That suite's real grid has no rows, so it draws no + column.
4. `StudioDesignSurface.formFields`: Preview offers no Add field, so its liveness case adds the field from the Layout toolbar and reopens Preview. DataPillar stays mounted, so a frozen memo still hands the remounted form the old array and the case stays red.
5. `DataPillar.flatTabs-12450`: the header-icon describe block is removed. Its subject retired, and the new file pins the header.
6. Two lucide imports (`Settings2`, `MoreHorizontal`) were removed from the file's import block. They were read only by the removed controls.

## Screenshots (1280 px; local console on its own HotCRM backend under `objectstack dev --fresh`)

HotCRM is read-only under `objectstack dev`, so these use a local writable base package 'Studio Test' with a published `st_ticket` object and one record. Each shot was taken after one field was added from the grid's + so that the save status shows. A DOM probe in the same run read the header's visible controls outside the tab row as an empty list on every tab, and the right slot as `Saved 04:31 PM`.

## Tests (final head `350de9a`; from the worktree root, through the shared verify lock)

- **New:** `DataPillar.headerActions-12511.test.tsx`, 3 tests. The header's controls outside the tab row are identical on Records, Form, Settings and back on Records, and that set is only the mobile rail toggle. Object settings, More and the header Add field are absent, and the Settings tab opens the panel. The same holds on a read-only package.
- **Updated pin:** `DataPillar.formToolbar-12451`, test 'the toolbar Add field and the Records grid "+" are one action'. Each entry adds one field card and opens the field inspector. Before this PR it read 'More → Add field'.
- Every `DataPillar.*` and `StudioDesignSurface.*` file at `37e544f`: `Test Files 96 passed (96)`, `Tests 602 passed (602)`. The later commits add only the changeset and the screenshots.
- The 14 touched or new files at `350de9a`: `Test Files 14 passed (14)`, `Tests 63 passed (63)`.
- **Ablated once each.** Each mutation was written with an anchor count check and run, then restored to the HEAD blob, with the hash matching and `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - A header button rendered on every tab but Settings: `headerActions-12511` went red (`2 failed, 1 passed`); restored, `3 passed`.
  - The grid's `onAddColumn` swapped from `addField` to a no-op: `formToolbar-12451` 'one action' went red (`1 failed, 3 passed`); restored, `4 passed`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0, after building the dependency closure; the test tsconfig lists the new files. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell build`: exit 0, dist completeness verified.
- eslint on every touched file: 0 errors. The warnings are on lines this diff does not touch.
- Gates, exit 0 each: `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`, `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`, `pnpm check:changeset-claims`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `pnpm check:test-path-roots`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` answered NOT GOVERNED. The diff adds no `Intl.*` call.

## Acceptance notes

- On a published object with zero records, the Records tab offers no Add field. The list draws its empty state in place of the grid, so the + column is absent. The Form tab is the entry there, as the card intends ('Add field shows as a button on the Form tab only'). Carrier: none.
- `origin/main` moved one commit after the branch point (`9c2785b`, objectui#12496). It touches no studio-design or i18n file, and `git merge-tree` reports no conflict.

Changeset: `.changeset/12511-data-header-actions.md` (app-shell patch).
